Context: Conditions governing payment of lumpsum compensation.-

5. In the case of death of an employee while travelling on duty by Railways due to train accidents, the amount of ex gratia lumpsum compensation admissible will be reduced by the compensation, if any, received by the next of kin of the employee from the Railways.
